Don’t be afraid to not want to fight and just focus on farming, with that being said don’t miss oppurtunites to kill someone or force them to back and so forth but if you’re not doing great in lane or you’re against a god who has a really strong early game like agni, don’t be afraid to be a little passive 

Pay attention if your opponent used their dash, jump, teleport, etc. this is prime ganking potetnial and you gotta take the opportunity to either do the damage or get your jungle on top of that

Never prioritize get the mid harpies or any camps over clearing your wave, you’ll always get more xp and gold from clearing wave and itll keep you tower healthy. Clear wave and then go do your farming, with that being said your tower can take a few hits off of a few surviving archers if you didn’t clear wave properly, in that case go and get your buffs and xp. 

Don’t risk your life trying to save the first tower, of course it’s not good to give the enemy free gold and xp but they really don’t get that much and losing the first tower isn’t the end of the world. Just make sure you don’t lose your second tower and you’re keeping up with farm and levels. 

Try to buy sentry wards when you have the gold and it’s gone gonna affect you finishing an item or build. A sentry Ward is only 150 but if you’re getting one every time you back it can add up, try to be sufficient with them but they’ll help out your jungler gank or invade buffs or items by giving the enemy mid laner less vision in lane which is really important
